items.author: vamppsych
items.text:
This is the timeline. If you hold a card you can post here.

Art, thoughts, a photo from last night, a bad opinion about a mix. Log in up top and it goes straight up, nobody edits you. No card, no worries, the DMs are open and we do read them.

items.author: vamppsych
items.text:
Somebody is good at something. We show up and film it.

That covers a lot. Tattoos, sets, a room at 1am, a guy fixing his own gear in the parking lot. If the work is real, it shoots.
items.image_alt: Window light across a worn couch inside The Mix before the room fills

items.author: vamppsych
items.text:
Nobody sits against a wall.

The interview happens while the subject works. Needle in the skin. Bleach on the foil. Beat loading. People say better things when their hands are busy.
items.image_alt: Performer working the mic in green stage wash

items.author: vamppsych
items.text:
Blade Rave gallery is up. 44 frames.

In one of them and want the full res? Just ask. It's yours, it's free, it was always yours.
items.image_alt: A packed room in full red wash at Paper Tiger

items.author: vamppsych
items.text:
House rules are short.

No comments. Logins are for card holders only. Off the record stays off the record. The subject sees the cut before anybody else does. We'd rather lose a story than burn somebody who let us in the room.
